title: Responsive CSS: add tablet breakpoints (768px, 1024px), CSS Grid for AI loop 4-panel layout, and tile grid 2-column fallback
goal: The current CSS has only two media queries (900px and 640px) — no tablet support. The AI loop Mission Control UI (backlog-262) introduces a 4-panel layout that requires proper responsive design from the start. Fix: (1) ADD BREAKPOINTS: @media (max-width: 1280px) for large desktop adjustments, @media (max-width: 1024px) for tablet landscape, @media (max-width: 768px) for tablet portrait/large mobile, @media (max-width: 640px) for existing mobile. (2) AI LOOP 4-PANEL LAYOUT using CSS Grid: desktop (>1280px): 2-column main + 1-column sidebar (Current Action | What We Know + AI Reasoning | Timeline). tablet landscape (1024px): 2-column layout (Current Action + What We Know | AI Reasoning). tablet portrait (768px): 1-column stacked. mobile: 1-column with collapsible panels. (3) TILE GRID: at 1024px breakpoint: 3 columns → 2 columns (not the current 3→1 jump at 900px). At 768px: 2 columns → 1 column. (4) SETTINGS TABS: at 768px, tabs become a horizontal scroll row (same height, no line break). At 640px, tabs become a select dropdown. (5) WIZARD: target input card full-width at 768px. Depth cards stack vertically at 640px. (6) SIDEBAR: collapses to icon-only at 768px, hidden completely at 640px (hamburger menu). Use CSS Grid and Flexbox. Keep the existing design tokens from backlog-199 (--spacing-xs etc.) — this task adds the responsive layout rules using those tokens.
scope: UI responsiveness review 2026-05-07: CSS has only 2 media queries, missing tablet. AI loop 4-panel UI requires proper CSS Grid from the start. Tile grid jumps from 3→1 columns with no 2-column intermediate. Settings tabs and wizard have no tablet layout.
generation_reason: AI loop 4-panel layout + settings tabs + wizard need responsive design. Only 2 media queries currently. Must address before AI loop UI goes live.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add responsive rules to existing CSS. Do not change component design, colours, or typography. Do not add new CSS classes — only media query variants of existing ones.

success_criteria: Tile grid: 3 columns at >1024px, 2 columns at 768-1024px, 1 column at <768px.
Settings tabs: horizontal scroll at 768px, dropdown at 640px.
Wizard depth cards: stack vertically at 640px.
No regression in existing E2E tests.
